data.name: Rashan
data.gender_notes: Rashan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is content and pleasantly satisfied with what Allah has given him. The name Rashan carries the meaning “Content, Pleasantly Satisfied” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Rashan usually hope their child will grow to embody content, pleasantly satisfied and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a strong connection to Allah and a deep sense of gratitude and contentment
data.etymology: Rashan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Content, Pleasantly Satisfied.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rashan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: رشان
in_arabic.long_meaning: رشان هو اسم عربي مشتق من الجذر رشا الذي يعني الهداية أو الإرشاد، وم menc في القرآن الكريم في سورة التوبة، ويحمل هذا الاسم معنىً روحياً عميقاً في الإسلام حيث يشير إلى من يرشد الناس إلى الصراط المستقيم

in_urdu.name: رشان
in_urdu.long_meaning: رشان ایک عربی نام ہے جو رشا کے gốc سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رہنمائی یا ہدایت کرنا، اور یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورہ توبہ میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور اس نام کا روحانی意义 اسلام میں بہت گہرا ہے جہاں یہ سیدھے راستے کی طرف رہنمائی کرنے والے کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: रशन
in_hindi.long_meaning: रशन एक अरबी नाम है जो रशा के मूल से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है मार्गदर्शन या दिशा देना, और यह नाम कुरान में सूरह तौबा में उल्लेखित है, और इस नाम का आध्यात्मिक अर्थ इस्लाम में बहुत गहरा है जहां यह सीधे मार्ग की ओर मार्गदर्शन करने वाले की ओर संकेत करता है

data.cultural_impact: The name Rashan may not have a widely recognized cultural impact as it is not a frequently used name in the Islamic world. However, the meaning of the name emphasizes an individual's contentment and satisfaction with what Allah has bestowed upon them. In a society that often values material wealth and possessions above all else, this name encourages a sense of inner peace and gratitude.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rashan signifies an individual's submission and acceptance of Allah's will for their life. It implies trust and faith in Allah's plan and a deep sense of gratitude for the blessings received. This name can serve as a reminder to focus on the present moment and find joy and satisfaction in the gifts and blessings that Allah has provided, rather than constantly seeking more.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Content, Pleasantly Satisfied" symbolizes One who is content and pleasantly satisfied with what Allah has given him. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rashan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of content, pleasantly satisfied.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rashan was the name of a powerful Arab tribe that controlled the Hejaz region in the 7th century. The name Rashan carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Rashan was an important tribe in the early Islamic period, and their influence extended beyond the Arabian Peninsula.
